AWC.Settings.HandRingSlots.Name: Hand & Ring Slot Reference
AWC.Settings.HandRingSlots.Reference: Melee (bottom-left) and Ranged (bottom-right) each hold a Main and Secondary hand-slot. Weapons keep hand-identity — whatever's in your Main hand always shows as that side's Main, whatever's in Secondary always shows as that side's Secondary. A two-handed weapon occupies both hands and merges into one slot on its side. Main Ring / Secondary Ring (bottom-center) work the same auto-fill/drag-swap way.
AWC.Settings.HandRingSlots.ShieldReferen: A shield has no hand-identity of its own: it always renders as the Main box of whichever side has no weapon of that type (defaulting to Ranged if neither hand holds a weapon), and hides that side's Secondary box. Two shields can be equipped at once — one on each side's Main — leaving no Secondary available. A two-handed weapon and a shield can never be equipped together. A shield (or weapon) with the ignoresHandSlot marker doesn't use a hand at all — it appears in the dedicated Exempt slot above the Necklace instead.
